import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Aggregate total sales by day
daily_sales = coffee_sales.groupby(coffee_sales['date'].dt.date)['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='date', y='total', marker='o', color='brown')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Daily Total Sales in the Coffee Shop', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Aggregate total sales by day
daily_sales = coffee_sales.groupby(coffee_sales['date'].dt.date)['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='date', y='total', marker='o', color='brown')

# Customize the plot
plt.title('Daily Total Sales in the Coffee Shop', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=14)
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
